context: M11 o5. Bauer's office above the arcade. Fluorescent hum. Bauer sweats.

lines.speaker: char.ray_bauer
lines.text: Del! Ha! Running from Lonnie? Everybody runs from Lonnie. Sit, sit.

lines.speaker: char.ray_bauer
lines.text: I sell quarters. What people watch for a quarter is between them and God.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: You're sweating, Ray. It's sixty degrees in here.

lines.speaker: char.ray_bauer
lines.text: Somebody downtown keeps asking about Wurtz. Asking me. Why me?

lines.speaker: char.ray_bauer
lines.text: Legit. That's the word. I'm gonna be so legit you'll be bored.
